author: 0w3n6325
content:
Today it depends on the vc the node operator is using. There are some slight differences between them. But generally they resend once per epoch. Increasing the timestamp and re-signing only when the fee-recipient or gas-limit has changed.

We cache them and ignore them the new ones if the timestamp hasn't changed.
